description: This file defines data models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing key metrics data from Finviz, including query parameter models, data models, and a fetcher with methods for data extraction and transformation.

classes.name: FinvizKeyMetricsQueryParams
classes.description: Model for query parameters to fetch Finviz key metrics, allowing multiple symbols.

classes.name: FinvizKeyMetricsData
classes.description: Data model representing various key metrics from Finviz, with optional float fields and descriptive metadata.

classes.name: FinvizKeyMetricsFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class that retrieves and processes key metrics data from Finviz, including methods for data extraction and validation.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a FinvizKeyMetricsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches raw key metrics data for given symbols from Finviz, handling API calls, data parsing, and error management.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Validates and converts raw data dictionaries into FinvizKeyMetricsData instances.
